<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bucket_desc(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(19,40) for c in range(24,52) if a[r][c] not in ('B','G')]
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    from collections import Counter
    col=Counter(a[r][c] for r,c in cells)
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),dict(col))
print('before LEFT:', bucket_desc(current_frame))
r=action([{'action':'LEFT'}],intent='explore')
print('after LEFT:', bucket_desc(current_frame), {k:r[k] for k in ('board_changed','no_impact')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bucket_desc(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(19,40) for c in range(24,52) if a[r][c] not in ('B','G')]
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    from collections import Counter
    col=Counter(a[r][c] for r,c in cells)
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),dict(col))
print('before LEFT:', bucket_desc(current_frame))
r=action([{'action':'LEFT'}],intent='explore')
print('after LEFT:', bucket_desc(current_frame), {k:r[k] for k in ('board_changed','no_impact')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
